details:
I would like to request a feature that automatically saves text chat messages to a log file in VRChat. Specifically, it would be very helpful if all text chat messages visible to a user—sent by people in the same instance—could be recorded locally.

At least within the Japanese VRChat community, there are a significant number of players who prefer using text chat and may not be able to use voice chat for various reasons. A logging feature would become a key component of tools that support and enhance communication with these users, helping make interactions more accessible and inclusive.

This feature would improve usability in many situations, such as reviewing important information shared during events, meetings, or social interactions, and keeping accurate records when needed. Ideally, the log file could include timestamps and usernames, and be stored locally with appropriate privacy considerations.

Having an official logging function would also reduce the need for external tools or workarounds, helping ensure stability, accuracy, and compliance with platform policies.
title: Add Text Chat Logging for Instance Participants
